title: feat(nm2readx): neighbor-read of M at t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, x-probes, neighbor-read of M: HOLDs at all four probes, hold/hold - the only M-read cell in the opposite seed where both bits hold. Contrasts with the y-probe (fail/fail, #7385) and z-probe (fail/hold, #7363) frames on the same seed.
